steps.en: The hirer opens the furnish page and finds their outstanding notices
steps.id: Hirer membuka halaman furnish dan menemukan notice outstanding miliknya
steps.why_en: Looking up the hirer's notices depends on encrypted personal data that the demo remark says could not be read.
steps.why_id: Pencarian notice hirer bergantung pada data pribadi terenkripsi yang menurut catatan demo tidak bisa dibaca.

steps.en: Furnishing is only offered at the pre-set reminder stages
steps.id: Furnish hanya ditawarkan pada stage pengingat yang sudah ditetapkan

steps.en: The hirer enters the driver's details and submits the application
steps.id: Hirer mengisi data driver dan mengirim aplikasinya

steps.en: The application is checked automatically; doubtful ones go to an officer
steps.id: Aplikasi diperiksa otomatis; yang meragukan diteruskan ke officer

steps.en: The furnished driver becomes the notice's current offender
steps.id: Driver yang di-furnish menjadi offender saat ini pada notice

steps.en: The notice moves onto the driver follow-up track as the workflow requires
steps.id: Notice masuk ke jalur tindak lanjut driver sesuai alur kerja
steps.why_en: The workflow document in Annex 1A is not available, so the exact rules cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Dokumen alur kerja di Annex 1A tidak tersedia, jadi aturan persisnya belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: The driver then gets the next letter through the print vendor
steps.id: Driver kemudian mendapat surat berikutnya lewat vendor cetak
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is blocked by a setting and the daily run is switched off, yet the notice still moves on.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dikunci oleh setting dan proses harian dimatikan, tapi notice tetap maju.
